description.label: Description
description.value:
Major Physical Mutation

One of your hands turns into carapaced pincer claws similar to that of a crab. If you are left with only one hand see @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.zyocWSzEZEC826NS]{Ampuiated Parts (Hand)}. If you're left with no hands your dexterity drops to 0. The claws cannot wield anything or use Dexterity Skills. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.AtpAudHA4ybXVlWM]{Weapon} (SB+4) and @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.KynNUYYKzTMeHrKl]{Constrictor} Creature Traits, as well as the @UUID[Compendium.artantares-mutations.items.Item.JIv9RZGeYoaPPGiM]{Protective Skin} (Carapace) mutation. This Mutation can only be received if you have at least one clawless hand.
